facts.fact: Tech Review Africa reports Ghana launched the ICC-TikTok Digital Commerce Labs to teach young entrepreneurs and small businesses digital marketing, e-commerce, digital payments and financial literacy, with the Deputy Communications Minister giving the keynote; no participant numbers or locations are stated.
